nodes.label: Vercel Apex-Only Custom Domain Flow
nodes.summary: Merchant attaches ONE A record (@→76.76.21.21); the platform auto-attaches www at the Vercel project level. Avoids locked CNAME conflicts on GoDaddy/Namecheap-style registrars where www CNAME cannot be edited.

nodes.label: Vercel verified vs live Domain State Trap
nodes.summary: Vercel's verified:true means ownership link confirmed — independent of DNS. Live requires verified && !misconfigured. Showing a green badge on verified alone leaves customers hitting the registrar parking page.

nodes.label: Auto-Attach www on Apex Domain Register
nodes.summary: When a merchant attaches an apex domain, the platform calls Vercel's domain API twice — once for the apex, once for the www variant — and soft-fails the www add. Never auto-attach www of a subdomain input (guard with parts.length===2).

nodes.label: CSS letter-spacing Breaks Arabic Shaping Engine
nodes.summary: Non-zero CSS letter-spacing defeats the browser's Arabic shaping engine, rendering isolated glyph forms instead of connected script. Global :lang(ar) reset with letter-spacing:normal !important is the correct one-line fix — per-element patching of 78+ Tailwind tracking-[X] sites is impractical and fragile.

nodes.label: :lang(ar) Reset Requires html lang Attribute on SSR
nodes.summary: The global :lang(ar) CSS reset only fires if <html lang='ar'> is actually set server-side. Requires cookie-based locale detection in layout.tsx (see locale-cookie-ssr). Without SSR wiring, the reset rule has nothing to match.

nodes.label: Bilingual JSONB Editor Parity Trap
nodes.summary: When a JSONB column has a paired *Ar sibling (e.g. steps + stepsAr), the admin form must render and mutate both arrays in lockstep. AI bulk-sweep writes both sides; the storefront renders both correctly; but an EN-only editor leaves merchants unable to refine the AR content without SQL access.

nodes.label: JSONB Bilingual Array Alignment Recipe
nodes.summary: Four-step recipe for bilingual JSONB array editors: (1) initialize EMPTY_HOWTO with both arrays, (2) alignStepsAr() normalizes null/length-mismatched AR arrays on load, (3) add/remove step handlers mutate both arrays at the same index, (4) render side-by-side grid with lang=ar dir=rtl on the AR input.

nodes.label: Bilingual Column Audit Rule on Schema Change
nodes.summary: Any time a *Ar column is added to a Prisma schema, the admin form for that table MUST be audited to ensure it renders both the EN and AR sides. The storefront rendering the AR side correctly is not a proxy for admin parity — they are independent surfaces.
